confidence_notes: Jeonju food prices use a May 2026 cost-of-living aggregate, which reports only five contributors in the past 18 months; the mid-range meal estimate is smoothed toward South Korea typical prices. Cocktail and wine-glass estimates use their price relationship to Jeonju draft beer, informed by Korea-wide drink prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not live listing prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Jeonju-specific food prices are used where available, with South Korea-wide prices as a check. Accommodation is modeled on a mid-sized Korean provincial city with tourism demand around Hanok Village, rather than Seoul-level pricing.
